title: Ultimate Crispy Cutlet & Spicy Vodka/Pesto Ciabatta ('Best Sando Ever')
ingredients: 2 thin-sliced chicken breast cutlets, breaded in seasoned flour, egg wash, and panko/Parmesan
4 slices fresh mozzarella or provolone cheese
1/3 cup basil pesto + 1/2 cup spicy vodka or marinara sauce
4 thin slices prosciutto or crispy bacon
Fresh arugula, balsamic glaze, and grated Parmigiano-Reggiano
instructions: Pan-fry the panko-Parmesan breaded chicken cutlets in shallow oil over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until deeply golden and crispy.
Top each cutlet with a spoonful of warm vodka/marinara sauce and fresh mozzarella, then broil 2 minutes until bubbly.
Toast the ciabatta rolls, slather with basil pesto, layer with crispy prosciutto, the cheesy chicken cutlet, fresh arugula, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
